title: Shinonome Akito — Unexpected Farewell Gift〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, there you are!
That's fine, but what's going on?
We waited here like you asked.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had to go back and get this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A cake box?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, call it a little treat.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: A treat?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something sweet after a tough practice doesn't sound bad, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, can we open it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, cheesecake! And it looks amazing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This cake... Is it the one from...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what are you guys talking about? Do you know where this came from, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's the cake Akito and Momoi won when we played competitive Hanetsuki together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ena and I ended up losing to them, which meant that we had to treat them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you played for cheesecake?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, Ena... My sister likes this a lot, but I decided to get some more, since it ended up being so good.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And you got enough for all of us?
That's so thoughtful of you, Akito!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Now that the cake is here, I should start getting ready.
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, this cake must be really good if it made Akito go back for more...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If I were in his shoes, I'd want to have it all to myself, you know...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I understand what you mean, Len, but these kinds of things taste much better when you share them with others.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, KAITO, you're really gonna say that?
Just the other day, when I asked for a bit of your ice cream, you said that I couldn't have any.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, there's gotta be more to this story.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There has to be a reason why you suddenly decided to buy cake for all of us. You hardly ever do anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No reason in particular. I just felt like it.
se_walk_women_004_2

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here are the things you asked for, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What things?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: These. My special whipped cream, some fruits and fruit sauce.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As we discussed the other day, these should make for some excellent toppings, yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, MEIKO, that was supposed to be a...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, did you ask for MEIKO's help?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've gone to a lot of trouble considering you “just felt like doing this”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Cut me some slack...
Doesn't it make sense to want to have this cake in the best way possible?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, just try it.
Your world's gonna get turned upside down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you sure you want to raise the bar that high?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You'll see what I mean.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It must be just that good♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, I'll get some plates for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They all seem to be enjoying it very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(This cake's seriously good...
Why didn't Ena tell me about this place sooner?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, I think I'll have some now.
As for toppings... I'm gonna start with some whipped cream.
